title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Rentals Held Side by Side
content:
A renter may hold any number of car rentals at the same time, including overlapping rentals in different cities, and each rental carries its own rate class and its own ledger. Two rentals with the same supplier, the same collection branch and overlapping times are referred for duplicate review before collection, because a supplier holds one vehicle against one driver. Nothing is aggregated between rentals: included mileage, protection products and free additional drivers belong to the rental that carries them and are never moved. A driver named on two rentals at once is still one driver, and the young or senior driver fee is charged on each rental separately.

**The rule in parts.**

| Question put to the desk | What governs it on the Car Rental Rate Classes |
|---|---|
| How many rentals may one renter hold? | Any number, overlapping or not, in one city or several |
| What does a second rental inherit from the first? | Nothing: its own rate class and its own ledger |
| When is a duplicate review raised? | The same supplier, the same collection branch and overlapping times, before collection |
| Does an entitlement move between rentals? | Included mileage, protection products and free additional drivers stay on the rental that carries them |
| Is one driver charged once? | The young or senior driver fee is charged on each rental separately |

**Illustration on hypothetical rentals.** Suppose a renter holds two rentals with the same supplier in the same city, one collecting on the Inclusive Flex Rate and one on the Pay Now Standard Rate, with overlapping times from the same branch. The matching supplier, branch and overlap mean the pair is referred for duplicate review before collection. The free additional driver carried by the Inclusive Flex Rate remains on that rental alone; the Pay Now Standard Rate does not acquire it. If the two rentals instead ran from different branches, the three conditions for the duplicate review would not all hold together, and the rentals would simply stand side by side on their own terms.
